findings.detail: F16 used a distribution rate of 20.5559%, but the 2025 financial highlights show common stock distributions of 0.91 per share, implying an annual distribution rate of about 8.53% against average NAV per share and below the 15.6% heuristic threshold.
The distribution-history table includes a cumulative Total cash distributions line of 8.41 that should not be used as the 2025 annual distribution amount.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The filing-level financial-highlight schedule gives 2025 common stock distributions from distributable earnings of 0.91 per share and net investment income to average net asset value of 10.4%. Using average net assets of 252.683m and weighted average shares of 23.689363m implies average NAV per share of about 10.67 and an annual distribution rate of about 8.53%, which is below 10.4% * 1.5 = 15.6%. The flagged observed value of 20.55593869731803% is therefore not supported by the 2025 annual source rows and is consistent with leakage from the cumulative Total cash distributions row of 8.41 in the distribution-history table.
